subject: economics
objective: What are the unemployment and participation rates?
instruction: In Marlow the working-age population is 250,000. Of them 64% are in the labour force and exactly 90% of the labour force has a job. In counts: The labour force is 160,000, the number employed is 144,000 and the working-age population is 250,000. Unemployed = labour force - employed. Unemployment rate = unemployed / labour force. Participation rate = labour force / working-age population. Employment-population ratio = employed / working-age population. Required: unemployed, unemployment rate, participation rate, employment population ratio.
